name: AI in Health and Life Sciences: The One-Hour Briefing
description: A free one-hour briefing built on eight real jobs, not an overview: auditing an ambient-scribe note, answering a portal message from an AI draft, acting on a sepsis alert, reading a triage-flagged CT worklist, reviewing a prior-authorization request, checking AI-suggested codes, and triaging drug and device safety reports. Each lesson shows where AI helps, where it must not decide, and the rule that governs that exact task.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Health and Life Sciences

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI in Health and Life Sciences: The One-Hour Briefing

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 8 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 15 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits

alignment.targetName: Audit an AI-drafted visit note or portal reply against its source and identify fabricated findings, changed doses, omitted facts and missed red flags before signing or sending
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Distinguish an FDA-authorized AI device, such as a radiology triage tool or Prenosis Sepsis ImmunoScore, from an EHR-embedded model whose regulatory status and local validation the hospital must confirm, and explain what a flag or a missing flag does and does not mean
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Compute a tool's local positive predictive value and alert burden from a worklist or alert log, and decide what to escalate to an AI governance committee
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Identify, for a named health-plan, coding or safety task, the decision AI may support and the decision a qualified human must make, citing the governing rule (Medicare Advantage individualized review, California SB 1120, E/M medical decision making, the False Claims Act, 21 CFR 314.80 and 600.80, 21 CFR 803.50 and 803.53)
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Apply HIPAA business associate and minimum-necessary requirements, Section 1557 (45 CFR 92.210 for decision support tools and 92.201(c)(3) for machine translation) and California AB 3030 disclosure to a proposed use of AI in a specific workflow
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes
